story.titleZh: 遇见山姆，2025年阿美科STEM挑战赛三名获奖者之一
story.summaryZh: 山姆是2025年阿美科STEM挑战赛的三名获奖者之一。他在AMR技术中心的为期一周的沉浸式项目中对他的空气动力学专业知识进行了测试，分析了赛车并探索了如何优化其在COTA赛道的性能。

story.summaryEn:
Meet Sam, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge.
His week-long Immersion Programme at the AMR Technology Campus put his aerodynamics expertise to the test, analysing the car and exploring how it could be optimised for the COTA track.
